question: Which jointly frozen public non-sorting optimization pairs have two reliable source endpoints under the same prompt-conditioned DiffusionGemma interface?

design.selection_rule: Screen all four frozen pairs. A pair is eligible for a later composition experiment only if all three A and all three B outputs pass their predefined lexical endpoint gates.

control_gates.prompt_alignment: A and B complete prompt sequences must have the exact frozen token count recorded for their pair and require no padding.
control_gates.endpoint_pass: All six outputs for the pair must retain the predefined named source technique.
control_gates.failure_behavior: Preserve every failed endpoint and exclude that pair from midpoint interpretation without replacing it.

follow_up.two_or_more_pairs_pass: Freeze one midpoint and direct-prompt comparison over every passing pair.
follow_up.one_pair_passes: Run a bounded single non-sorting replication and report the limited scope.
follow_up.no_pairs_pass: Stop non-sorting interpolation tests and report endpoint controllability as the blocker.

limitations: This experiment tests endpoint controllability only, not composition.
The workloads are public synthetic tasks rather than private Darwin programs.
Automated gates require later raw-text review and do not replace blinded evaluation.
